name: Lucky Hook
summary: An ownerless canonical ETH/LUCK pool that takes hook-level swap fees, funds Chainlink VRF, and distributes periodic rewards to eligible mature buyers.

integration.standardSwapBehavior: Empty hookData is accepted and non-empty hookData reverts. Delta-return fee accounting changes swap settlement, so the pool is not vanilla even though ordinary swaps do not require custom hook data.

dedicatedRouter.purpose: The repository's authenticated payer and recipient settlement surface for the canonical product flow.

hookData.emptyDataBehavior: Only empty hookData is accepted; non-empty hookData reverts.

officialUniversalRouter.notes: Empty hookData is structurally compatible, but no exact deployed Universal Router fork matrix or final wallet-settlement evidence has been supplied.

multihop.notes: No current Universal Router multihop evidence has been supplied for the return-delta fee path.

quoteDiscovery.notes: The hook does not implement the Uniswap ALF indicative-quote interfaces.

finalAmountEvidence.notes: The hook changes settlement with return deltas; raw PoolManager Swap amounts are not sufficient proof of trader-final input and output.

callbackSemantics.name: beforeInitialize
callbackSemantics.reentrancyBoundary: Initialization is restricted to the immutable registrar and canonical pool configuration.
callbackSemantics.gasBoundary: No independent callback gas cap is evidenced.

callbackSemantics.name: beforeSwap
callbackSemantics.reentrancyBoundary: Specified-fee paths call PoolManager.take; other quadrants defer fee collection to afterSwap. VRF is never requested from a PoolManager callback.
callbackSemantics.gasBoundary: No independent callback gas cap is evidenced; return-delta gas needs target-chain fork measurement.

callbackSemantics.name: afterSwap
callbackSemantics.reentrancyBoundary: Fee-bearing paths call PoolManager.take, and buy paths call RewardToken.openCanonicalBuyCredit. VRF is requested only by the separate permissionless requestRound entry point once its interval, reward-pot, and buyer-count gates pass.
callbackSemantics.gasBoundary: PoolManager fee collection and buyer-credit gas need target-chain fork measurement; VRF request gas belongs to the separate requestRound transaction.

security.authorityModel: The source describes an ownerless hook with immutable token, PoolManager, VRF wrapper, registrar, and reward parameters.
knownRisks: The repository states that it has not been audited.
Reward liveness depends on Chainlink VRF funding, fulfillment, and timeout recovery.
Fee, liability, buyer-index, and random-selection invariants require independent production review.
